Ground Report: As India's elderly population grows, Gurugram is witnessing a rise in premium senior-living communities promising security, healthcare, companionship and a worry-free life. With traditional family support systems changing, developers are tapping into a growing demand for luxury retirement homes. But is this the future of elderly care, or is growing old with dignity becoming a privilege only the wealthy can afford?
Producer: Tista Roy Chowdhury
Edit: Prince Kesari
Camera: Madhur Shyam
